purpose: Professional shared-asset intake and admission ledger for Project 42, DR Companion, and future licensed client work. Source-pack candidates precede individual asset review.
sharedRawLicensePolicy: CC0-1.0 only. Other sources require project-only or access-controlled treatment unless their exact license is independently recorded as redistribution-permitted.

source.creator: Kenney
source.licenseNotes: The official Nature Kit page declares Creative Commons CC0. The retrieved archive includes License.txt identifying Nature Kit 2.1 and repeats CC0 1.0 commercial-use permission.

review.targetCamera: Project 42 third-person tabletop camera and DR Companion room-to-overworld camera
notes: Retrieved archive is preserved outside Git at work/art/vendor/kenney/nature-kit and is intentionally ignored.
Archive inventory: 329 GLB models, companion FBX/OBJ/DAE/STL formats, and PNG source textures; no member is runtime-admitted by this source-pack record.
First curation pass will test rocks, broadleaf and conifer trees, bushes, ground dressing, cliffs, and bridges at actual camera scale before individual approval.

import.sourceFormat: ZIP source pack containing GLB, FBX, OBJ, DAE, STL, PNG, and license evidence
import.intendedRuntimeFormat: Individual reviewed GLB source files imported by Godot; optimized project derivatives are tracked separately
import.pivotAndGroundContact: Not yet inspected per mesh; each admitted mesh must sit at y=0 or declare a placement offset
import.materialStrategy: Keep simple source colors only where they support the chunky tabletop palette; replace or standardize materials only after camera review
import.collisionOrSelection: No runtime collision, selection, or navigation behavior is granted by a source-pack record
import.lodStrategy: Per-mesh decision after actual scale and count are measured; do not assume all 329 assets are appropriate for runtime use
